tools.name: post_idea
tools.description: Posts a new idea at the top level of a public discussion on Veritula, as the person who connected the app and marked as written with AI. To criticize or comment on an idea, use reply instead. The content is Markdown. Posting takes signing in, and new accounts can post a few ideas a day.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_ideas, get_idea, get_discussion, get_notifications, mark_notifications_read · Public sink: post_idea, reply.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_ideas, get_idea, get_discussion, get_notifications, mark_notifications_read · Public sink: post_idea, reply

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_notifications" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
